净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Crash precursor: intraday range widens relative to close-to-close volatility before a regime breakdown. This captures the shift where daily extremes expand faster than daily returns, indicating fragility and potential crash. Cross-sectional ranking selects stocks with the most extreme range/vol divergence.

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(divide(subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20)), 2)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20))
  3. 3. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow)
  4. 4. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20)
  5. 5. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)
使用字段：
列含义说明
AdjClose后复权收盘复权后的收盘价，动量/收益类计算常用
AdjHigh后复权最高复权后的当日最高价
AdjLow后复权最低复权后的当日最低价

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 range_：high - low
  2. 计算 close_ret：close.pct_change()
  3. 计算 range_shifted：range_.shift(1)
  4. 计算 close_vol：close_ret.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).std()
  5. 计算 range_ma：range_.滚动窗口(5, min_periods=3).mean()
  6. 计算 factor：range_ / close_vol
  7. 计算 factor：factor.滚动窗口(2).mean()
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_breakdown_breadth(df): df_copy = df.copy() range_ = df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'low'] close_ret = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change() "com"># align range to start at period 1 range_shifted = range_.shift(1) "com"># rolling volatility of close returns over 20 days close_vol = close_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std() "com"># rolling average of range over 5 days range_ma = range_.rolling(5, min_periods=3).mean() "com"># ratio of current range to close volatility as a breakdown signal "com"># when range expands relative to close vol, potential breakdown factor = range_ / close_vol.replace(0, np.nan) "com"># smooth a bit with previous period to reduce noise factor = factor.rolling(2).mean() df_copy["str">'factor_breakdown_breadth'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_breakdown_breadth']
